{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Celadon University |characters=タマムシ大学 |japanese=Tamamushi University |image=Celadon University ID Card.jpg |imagesize=250px |region=Kanto |epicode=EP136 |episode=Chikorita's Big Upset }} '''Celadon University''' (Japanese: '''タマムシ大学''' ''{{tt|Tamamushi|Celadon}} University'') is a university located in [[Celadon City]]. Celadon University is a special university which only children of primary school age can attend. From March 1998 to February 1999, Shogakukan Learning Magazines ran a [[Tamamushi University campaign|promotional campaign]] in which readers could enroll in the fictional university, and complete various exams to receive prizes. The university's crest—as shown in the commemorative items—consists of a Magikarp, {{p|Gyarados}}, and the Kanji 学 ''gaku'' (meaning "to learn"). ==In the games== While Celadon University does not appear in the games, it is mentioned in one of the [[Human Records]] in {{g|Pokopia}}. A research team from the university conducted a study into {{p|Pidgeot}}'s eyesight, allowing them to discover a specific strand of DNA that impacts eyesight. During the [[Tamamushi University campaign]], 30 players were awarded a special {{p|Magikarp}} that knows {{m|Dragon Rage}}, based on their performance in the Professor Exam. {{-}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|GS}}==== Celadon University is referred to several times in {{aniseries|GS}}. In ''[[EP136|Chikorita's Big Upset]]'', [[Nurse Joy]] mentioned that she studied a degree in Pokémon psychology at Celadon University. In ''[[EP163|Fossil Fools]]'', it was revealed that {{an|Professor Oak}} used to teach there, and [[Foster]] was one of his top students. ==In the manga== Following the Magikarp giveaway, the University has appeared in two manga series: [[Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!]] and [[Pokémon Adventures]]. In both manga, the appearance of the building is closely based on the artwork from the Student ID Card and the Magikarp with Dragon Rage is referenced in some way. [[File:Celadon University Adventures.png|thumb|left|120px|Celadon University in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Yellow}}==== Celadon University was first mentioned in ''[[PS043|Sea Sea Seadra]]'', when {{adv|Bill}} said he'd be taking his report on [[Viridian Forest]]'s ecology there and proposing it to the university once it was finished. Celadon University made its physical debut in ''[[PS046|Whacked by Marowak]]'', where [[Erika]] was seen giving a lecture about the Dragon Rage Magikarp. She was offered a full-time job at the university by Professor Matsumoto, but she declined because of her [[Gym Leader]] duties. [[File:Celadon University GDZ.png|thumb|200px|Celadon University in [[Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!]]]] ===Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!=== [[Shu]] visited Celadon University in ''[[GDZ06|The Challenge at Celadon University!]]''. To enter the university building, one must answer an exam question. The university has a large campus, consisting of a swimming pool, Chemical Research Laboratory, Pokémon Pharmaceutical Faculty, Pokémon Art faculty, a Pokémon Environmental Study Faculty, and the University Hospital, where Shu saved a Magikarp that knew Dragon Rage from a {{p|Machamp}}. A hospital worker awarded him with a university crest badge for his deed. {{-}} ==In the TCG== [[File:MagikarpUniversityPromo.jpg|thumb|200px|Tamamushi University Magikarp]] {{main|Magikarp (University promo)}} Entrants who completed the [[Tamamushi University campaign]]'s Hyper Professor Exam had a chance of being awarded the title "Hyper Professor".
